conditions.label_note: lowest mean IVS among threshold-eligible settings; minimum pair assignment was 0.667

random_control.construction: For each layer and directed source-target pair, sample a standard-normal vector using the deterministic seed sequence [base_seed, layer, source_group_index, target_group_index], then scale it to exactly the L2 norm of the matching raw centroid delta.
random_control.reuse_policy: Reuse the same generated random vector for every behavioral item with the same condition and directed pair.

opposite_direction_subset.vector: negative of the matching task-directed raw centroid delta

hook_semantics.operation: Add beta * selected_vector only to hidden_states[:, -1, :] of the block output tensor.
hook_semantics.prefill: Apply once to the final prompt-token block output used to predict the first generated token.
hook_semantics.cached_generation: On every later cached decode forward, apply to the sole newly processed last-token block output used to predict the next token.
hook_semantics.cache_policy: Do not alter previously stored KV-cache entries or retroactively alter previous token states.
hook_semantics.implementation_gate: Before behavioral evaluation, a separate tiny diagnostic must verify this exact hook location and call pattern under KV cache.

outcomes.malformed_or_non_short_answer_heuristic: An answer is flagged when it is empty after stripping, contains a newline, exceeds 12 whitespace-delimited tokens, or exceeds 160 characters.
outcomes.repetition_heuristic: Within a condition and source group in frozen dataset order, count adjacent outputs whose normalized answer strings are exactly equal; report the fraction over adjacent pairs.

stop_rule: Do not automatically expand. Pause after the pilot unless hooks are verified, effects are not obvious artifacts, and either real steering differs meaningfully from its matched-norm random control or the representation-derived conditions show interpretable behavioral differences. If all interventions resemble random perturbation, record the negative result and pause.
